lineage.reason: Provenance, unresolved membership and shared-omission boundary retained.

decision: Diagnose before choosing intervention. Synthetic evidence establishes no causation. Share six coordinators' two sessions; cap combined work at six engineer-days and existing monthly hosting. Names stay within private service/authorized workspaces; preserve documented CSV and concurrent attendance entry. Test isolation, including split center. Field success requires next 40 exports: median handling <=12 minutes, intended sets >=95%, zero cross-center records.
